notes.title: Update 1.0.II
notes.content:
- Dying on a bonus level no longer loses points
- Adjusted level D)IV for clarity
- Adjusted level 4)IV to make it less frustrating when revisiting it

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed section in level V)E where you could get soft-locked
[*] Adjusted level 2
[/list]

Looking forward to release in a few days!

notes.title: Update 0.XVI.C
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added log to level 9, so now you can actually get all of the logs, heh…
[*] Fixed error with logs in levels G, V, and E)V not affecting the indicator on the level map. (Sorry!) If you’re trying to find all of the logs and are stuck, try checking these levels.
[*] The % indicator on save files is now more accurate.
[/list]

That takes care of all of the bugs/issues I am aware of. Hopefully this is the last update before launch, but who knows! Maybe some levels will still need to be tweaked.

notes.title: Update 0.XVI.B
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted “Wait, what?!?!” achievement
[*] Adjusted “Explorer” achievement so that you can actually get it lol
[*] Map actually centers on the current level now like it’s supposed to
[*] Fixed bug where map dialog wouldn’t go away when the game is paused
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.XVI.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted level 9)IX
[*] Added full screen toggle
[*] Settings should no longer sync with cloud saves
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.XVI.0
notes.content:
There is now an introductory "cutscene" to give a little more context to the story, and a proper ending!

This means that the game is basically done other than minor improvements!

notes.title: Update 0.XV.1
notes.content: Fixed "This Again!?!?" and "Explorer" achievements. Turns out, if you don't call the function, it doesn't run.

notes.title: Update 0.XV.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted “A Void Dance” achievement
[*] Adjusted “Master of Direction” achievement (hopefully it won’t auto-grant it now)
[*] Added “Explorer” achievement. Unfortunately, if you have a save from a previous version of the game, you’ll have to re-visit any visited levels to get this achievement.
[*] Fixed collision issue on II
[*] Adjusted secret on VII
[*] Fixed visual glitch in X10
[*] Fixed visual glitch in J
[*] Adjusted map to make panning with the right stick better
[*] Updated log text (mostly just formatting)
[/list]

Some of the achievements still need testing.
